blockers.summary: The frozen repair shim, builder, continuation, admission, controls, and qualification helpers exact-bind the v1 JVM startup policy and/or v1 witness/control-capture-03 namespace. A v5 decision/plan/control cascade cannot pass those helpers by changing only artifact references.
blockers.required_successor: Create and independently review append-only v5-aware successors or a precisely source-bound wrapper chain. Preserve the frozen v1 sources and all historical evidence; do not broaden the frozen helper in place.

blockers.summary: The private08 policy names agent05 but its digest is UNSEALED. No v5 policy-bearing decision or plan may be treated as runtime-ready or hash-bound until the exact JAR bytes, source/build evidence, and full digest have been independently reviewed.

The reviewed ancestry design describes maximum_nodes=33, while private08 revision08 explicitly corrected the operative representation to at most 32 nodes with the terminal 32nd parent edge allowed and a 33rd edge rejected. The v5 cascade must bind the frozen private08 source/policy and must not carry the stale 33-node claim into receipts or validators.
blockers.resolution: Use exact private08 revision08 semantics: maximum_links=32, observer nodes length 1..32, truncation at length 32, and no acceptance of a 33rd parent edge. Preserve this as a source/evidence correction, not a semantic case change.

required_successor_direct_refs.fresh_namespace: Any future v5 control capture must use a new append-only namespace. Do not reuse control-capture-03 or present its v1 receipts as v5 evidence.
required_successor_direct_refs.closure_rule: The source closure must include every new direct helper/observer/JAR/policy/ref and recursively referenced fresh run, witness, identity, diagnostic, receipt and finalization artifact; old evidence refs remain unchanged and included.

semantic_and_evidence_limits.decision03_evidence_boundary: The required 169 evidence refs are inherited source material and include v4 observer/JAR references. Keeping them unchanged is allowed only while decision03 remains explicitly prospective and unsupported; they must not be described as v5 execution evidence. The new v5 observer/JAR/policy must be separately source- and hash-bound before any new control or qualification claim.
semantic_and_evidence_limits.identity_boundary: The command rows have no birth identity. Fresh native correlation preserves the existing two-snapshot polling identity boundary; it is not atomic command-row ownership and does not establish complete containment.
semantic_and_evidence_limits.ancestry_boundary: ProcessHandle ancestry is a bounded prospective sample. It may correlate only the short untracked command-absent version helper to an exact tracked PID/birth or invocation-host anchor. It cannot authorize semantic JVMs, replace native tracking, infer historical ownership, or fill a missing required role.
semantic_and_evidence_limits.failure_boundary: Wrong birth, foreign/recycled PID, disappeared or reparented helper, malformed/cyclic chain, unavailable or unanchored prefix, and truncated prefix before anchor remain fail-closed. An anchored unavailable/truncated suffix remains diagnostic-only with complete_descendant_coverage=false.
semantic_and_evidence_limits.resource_time_boundary: Keep the existing 6-control/12-arm/36-phase/75-second/900-second/4-GiB limits, launch/reserve/scratch accounting, one-slot lock, clock, marker, publication hold, and no-automatic-retry rules.
semantic_and_evidence_limits.qualification_boundary: No plan06 pending artifact, decision03 copy, projection or control clone is a qualified run. No historical offender cause or native04 result is reclassified.
